name: website-breadth-2026-09-21
purpose: Source-scoped evaluation of link classification and static HTML extraction beyond media
features: 84 bounded numeric context features and token features from the existing context candidate builder
label_policy: Explicit DOM-defined positive scopes, reviewed neutral auxiliary scopes, and other candidate URLs as source-scoped negatives. Source/URL dedup is used for metrics.
label_quality: Assistant-reviewed weak labels. Positives frozen before predictions; auxiliary annotations for three technical sources refined independently after initial evaluation.
training: No training or threshold tuning in this evaluation. Retire these sources from holdout status if used for subsequent development.
raw_captures: Ignored local backend/data/breadth-{cultural,technical,public}/ directories. Full-page replay requires exact hash-matching snapshots.
privacy: Public listing pages only; no account libraries, credentials, form submissions or private content.
limitations: Counts include historical development/regression pages, not 100 unseen test domains.
One listing per new site, not complete archives or proof of support for every page on each site.
Labels are source-scoped weak annotations. Out-of-scope links can still be useful in a different tracker. No model training or threshold tuning was performed.
Auxiliary scopes for three technical pages were refined by an independent reviewer after initial evaluation; positive scopes were unchanged. The initial report is retained.
Model metrics are conditional on generated candidates and must not be compared directly to full parser extraction recall.
Timings are local Windows replays, some concurrent, not isolated production latency benchmarks. Process RSS includes all four models and accumulated feature rows.
Refusals, robots exclusions, JavaScript shells and unreviewed captures do not count as evaluated websites.
Historical parser results are retained with their original reports, not pooled into a current accuracy score.
